$comment: Marin CSV security posture. The app is a static local-browser editor: selected file bytes are not uploaded. CSV-4 intentionally stores local recovery records in origin-scoped IndexedDB until explicit deletion or browser storage removal. Static CSP/referrer metadata is generated from this file. GitHub Pages cannot provide the listed header-only controls.

contentTypeOptions.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

permissionsPolicy.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

frameProtection.notes: Requires a header (X-Frame-Options) or a directive meta-delivered CSP ignores (frame-ancestors); neither is available on GitHub Pages.

exceptions.reason: GitHub Pages cannot serve custom HTTP headers, and meta-delivered CSP ignores frame-ancestors.
exceptions.riskDescription: The app is a local-browser file editor and performs no server-side transaction. Review the hosting limitation again before beta or if the workflow adds authentication or sensitive server actions.

exceptions.reason: Both require a real HTTP response header, which GitHub Pages does not serve.
exceptions.riskDescription: Standing gap shared by every MarinOS app on this hosting stack. See marin-digital-standards/security/standard.md.

exceptions.reason: CSV-4 permits deployment on a shared HTTPS origin. IndexedDB is isolated by origin rather than path or database name.
exceptions.riskDescription: Other code executing on the same origin is inside the same browser-storage security boundary. Sensitive-data use requires explicit County security and privacy review; a dedicated origin remains a future hardening option.
